title: ship-gate configuration (.shipgate.json)
description: Per-project configuration for the ship-gate pre-push quality-gate plugin. The runtime deep-merges this file over built-in defaults, so any subset of these properties is valid; omitted keys fall back to defaults. This schema is for editor autocomplete and validation only and does not drive runtime behavior.

commandSpec.description: Gate command. One of: null (auto-detect from the project), a string (one command), or an array of {command, when} suites for multi-suite / monorepo repos. A suite runs iff a changed file matches its `when` git-pathspecs (omitted/empty `when` = always); ANY in-scope suite exiting non-zero fails the gate.

command.description: Shell command for this suite (non-empty; an empty/missing command is a config error and fails the gate closed).

when.description: git pathspecs; the suite runs iff a changed file matches one (omitted or null = always run). Pathspec globbing: '*' spans '/', so '*.rules' matches at any depth and 'functions' matches everything under functions/; brace globs like '{a,b}' are NOT supported — list entries separately ('*.tsx', '*.jsx'). A whitespace-only or otherwise unevaluable entry makes the suite run rather than silently skip. A git exclude pathspec (e.g. ':!*.md') scopes normally — the suite runs on any non-excluded change and is correctly skipped only when EVERY changed file is excluded.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON Schema for editor tooling.

enabled.description: Opt-out switch. When enforcement is active for this repo (a per-repo .shipgate.json is present, or the global ~/.shipgate.json has defaultEnabled:true), set this to false to keep the config but pause enforcement. In the global ~/.shipgate.json, false is an unconditional machine-wide kill-switch.

defaultEnabled.description: GLOBAL ONLY (~/.shipgate.json): when true, gate every repo that has no per-repo .shipgate.json (default-on). Ignored inside a per-repo .shipgate.json. Set by the installer; remove ~/.shipgate.json or set false to revert to opt-in.

mainBranch.description: The protected branch that /ship merges into and the push-block hook guards.

gates.description: The standard quality gates run before a push.

reason.description: Why this gate is disabled, if it is. Recorded here (not just in a commit message) so the premise is auditable at ship time, not buried in history. When set, a detected config-drift signal (the repo now looks like it has this gate's capability) downgrades from a blocking [DRIFT] to an informational [DRIFT-ACK] — see 'since' and doctor.

since.description: Free-form date (e.g. 2026-06-13) the 'reason' was recorded. Lets a human eyeball staleness (an old date next to a capability the repo now clearly has is worth a second look) without any runtime expiry logic.

reason.description: Why this gate is disabled, if it is — see gates.tests.reason.

since.description: Free-form date the 'reason' was recorded — see gates.tests.since.

secretScan.description: Secret-scan gate that blocks pushes containing leaked credentials.

skill.description: The bundled skill invoked for this gate.

mode.description: UAT resolution mode. Only confidence-scoring is implemented.

heavyGates.description: Heavier gates suggested when a change is large or risky.

filesChanged.description: Suggest when at least this many files changed.

areasChanged.description: Suggest when at least this many distinct areas changed.

riskyPaths.description: Suggest when the change touches security-sensitive paths.

skill.description: The bundled skill invoked for this gate.

upgrade.description: Name of an external skill to prefer over the bundled one if installed. null means use the bundled skill.

diffLines.description: Suggest when the diff is at least this many lines.

riskyPaths.description: Suggest when the change touches security-sensitive paths.

release.description: Suggest when the change is a release.

regression.description: Advisory regression-testing strategy pointer, NOT an executable check — the bundled runner never runs a command for it. When enabled on a test-affecting change, /ship invokes the ai-regression-testing skill for guidance; it surfaces strategy and never blocks the ship on its own. For mechanical regression suites you want actually executed, add them to gates.tests.command as when-conditional entries (multi-suite gate). Off by default.

enabled.description: When true on a test-affecting change, /ship surfaces the regression-testing strategy skill (advisory only — runs no command, never blocks).

skill.description: The advisory strategy skill invoked for guidance (default ai-regression-testing). It is a guide, not an executable pass/fail check.

runWhen.description: When the advisory pointer fires. Only the test-affecting trigger is implemented.

reason.description: Why this advisory pointer is disabled, if it is. Documentation only — regression is not a command gate, so it has no drift detection; recording the premise here keeps it auditable alongside the command gates' reason fields.

scoping.description: Glob buckets used to classify a change. Built-in buckets are docs, ui, and security; custom buckets are allowed and must be string arrays.

docs.description: Globs that classify a path as documentation.

ui.description: Globs that classify a path as UI.

security.description: Globs that classify a path as security-sensitive.

autoDetect.description: Whether to auto-detect the deploy target.

warnOnPush.description: Whether to warn when a push targets a deploy-connected branch.

skipGates.description: Gates skipped on the hotfix path. tests, codeReview, secretScan, and security are always kept.

markerTtlSeconds.description: Freshness window, in seconds, for the pass-marker that authorizes a push.
